headline: 藝文新片新書評論
context: 藝文圈今天有幾則新作評論。神力女超人蓋兒．加朵主演的動作驚悚片《The Runner》，在倫敦街頭上演一場一小時內飛奔五英里救兒子的故事，評論普遍認為劇情老套、表現生硬。另外，愛爾蘭作家柯姆．托賓的新小說《The Bridge》，續寫加泰隆尼亞高山家庭的悲傷故事；雷恩．雷諾斯與肯尼斯．布萊納主演的冷戰喜劇《Mayday》，則以特工搭檔莫斯科冒險的荒謬情節，獲得不錯的評價。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: A string of London locations can’t save Amazon’s overly familiar B-movie dragged down by another ineffective performance by the Wonder Woman star We’re propelled on to an extremely familiar journey in Amazon’s quickie action thriller The Runner, both in reheated premise and strategic aim. The film is yet another example of a real-time assassination nightmare as an ordinary citizen is placed in an extraordinary situation, forced to do something terrible by someone terrible. Think Johnny Depp in Nick of Time, Rachel McAdams in Red Eye, Shia LaBeouf in Eagle Eye, or more recently, Taron Egerton in Carry-On and Meghann Fahy in Drop , with technology increasingly a key component. We’re also faced with what’s another strained attempt to turn Gal Gadot into a movie star, a mission that’s proved close to impossible after she broke out in Wonder Woman. Her streaming vehicles, like Red Notice and Heart of Stone , might have proved easy at-home hits (the latter was also surprisingly entertaining), but on the big screen, playing both a Disney villain and an Agatha Christie victim proved to be of little interest to audiences, who chose meme-ing her worst moments over turning up to see them. An action-first film like The Runner, disposable and undemanding, might seem like the safest place for Gadot’s rather limited skill set, but even with a role that asks more of her physically than emotionally, it’s still a rather awkward stretch. Luckily, she’s paired with real on-the-ground London locations, from Kentish Town to Somerset House, the city proving to be a scene-stealing co-star. Gadot plays Maia, a single mother and lawyer, who says goodbye to her diabetic son at school and starts her run to work (surely her son’s diabetes will not become an important part of the plot, right? ). But her day is soon interrupted by a nefarious “freelancer” working for a local crime boss, voiced by Damian Lewis. He has kidnapped her son and hacked his insulin dispenser, forcing him into a hypoglycemic coma, his life hanging in the balance until Maia agrees to murder a key witness she was supposed to be representing in court that morning. The film’s slight novelty is that Maia must run five miles to the hotel where he’s staying within an hour, no interruptions allowed. The slight 2026 update is that, in what’s increasingly becoming a lazy crutch for screenwriters, AI is an important weapon. Continue reading...
sources.title: The Runner review – Gal Gadot stumbles through derivative high-speed, low-rent thriller

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Deep sorrow mingles with illicit desire in this potent novella, the follow-up to a 2006 story about an isolated family in the Catalan mountains Twenty years ago, Colm Tóibín published a steadily desolating novella set in the high villages of the Catalan Pyrenees. A woman walks out of her house and her life, starts along the mountain road and disappears in the snow. Her son Miquel, failing to find her body, waits through the dark months for the thaw. A Long Winter, which appeared in a standalone volume and then as the final story in the 2006 collection Mothers and Sons, followed Miquel through dramatically extreme circumstances and patient endurance. It was told with the most restrained prose ever likely to be employed for a son’s view of vultures circling a corpse. Now, in The Bridge, a single year has passed in Miquel’s life and he is eking out an existence with his hurtful, unyielding father. The sheep are grazing their high summer pastures; a side hustle smuggling contraband brings in a little much-needed cash. In the bare conditions of the lonely farm, any warmth of feeling is a kind of contraband smuggled in by night; love between men is doubly illicit. The grave tenderness that grows between Miquel and his father’s maltreated servant Manolo gives The Bridge its emotional centre. These young men salve the emptiness with a few quiet words and touches. We sense their youthful beauty and resilience, their suppleness in a place of fixity. Continue reading...
sources.title: The Bridge by Colm Tóibín review – betrayal and survival in the High Pyrenees

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: An American fighter pilot teams up with a retired KGB officer for hijinks and hilarity in Soviet Russia Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh star in this goofy but entertaining action-comedy bromance set in the cold war 80s, when it seemed every red-blooded young guy in America adored Top Gun and wanted to be a US Navy fighter pilot. It’s got some outrageous close-quarter fight scenes – and who knew Branagh could bust out martial arts moves? Is he going to follow Bob Odenkirk into an unexpected action movie career? The final sequences of automotive mayhem in and around Moscow might remind you of the heady days of Roger Moore as James Bond. Reynolds is Troy Kelly (callsign “Assassin”), a supercool fighter pilot in 1987, who is always doing brave and brilliant stuff that isn’t in the rulebook, and cracking wise in the accepted Reynolds manner. But when his spy plane is shot down deep inside snowy and forested Soviet territory, Troy awakens from his coma to find himself in the log cabin of retired KGB man Nikolai Ustinov, cheerfully played by Branagh, who is a secret fan of all things American and obsessively rewatches Top Gun on samizdat VHS. He suggests to the stunned Troy that he simply stays in his cabin, watching the film with him, until the cold war is over. Continue reading...
sources.title: Mayday review – Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh set cold war bromance alight

thread_text:
藝文圈今天有幾則新作評論。蓋兒．加朵主演的動作驚悚片《The Runner》，在倫敦街頭演出一小時飛奔五英里救兒子的橋段，評論普遍認為劇情老套、演出生硬。愛爾蘭作家柯姆．托賓的新小說《The Bridge》，續寫加泰隆尼亞高山家庭的悲傷故事，評價相當不錯。雷恩．雷諾斯與肯尼斯．布萊納主演的冷戰喜劇《Mayday》，則以搞笑特工搭檔的莫斯科冒險獲得好評。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 9 月 2、3 日發佈的評論，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
藝文圈今天有幾則新作評論。蓋兒．加朵主演的動作驚悚片《The Runner》，故事是她飾演的單親媽媽必須在一小時內跑五英里橫越倫敦救回被綁架的兒子，評論普遍認為劇情老套、加朵的演出也不夠有說服力，是部標準的B級片。愛爾蘭作家柯姆．托賓的新小說《The Bridge》，是他二十年前描寫加泰隆尼亞高山孤寂家庭故事的續篇，這次寫的是主角米蓋爾與父親雇工之間壓抑而動人的情感，獲得不錯的評價。雷恩．雷諾斯與肯尼斯．布萊納主演的冷戰喜劇動作片《Mayday》，講一名美軍飛行員墜機蘇聯境內，意外和退休KGB探員成了朋友，荒謬又逗趣，評論反應正面。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 9 月 2、3 日發佈的評論。
voice_text: 藝文圈今天有幾部新作評論。先講電影。蓋兒．加朵主演的動作片《The Runner》，她飾演的單親媽媽得在一小時內跑五英里橫越倫敦救兒子，評論普遍覺得劇情老套，加朵的演出也不夠有說服力。書的部分，愛爾蘭作家柯姆．托賓的新小說《The Bridge》評價不錯，寫的是加泰隆尼亞高山上，一對父子和雇工之間壓抑又動人的情感。另一部電影，雷恩．雷諾斯和肯尼斯．布萊納主演的冷戰喜劇《Mayday》，講一名美軍飛行員墜機蘇聯，意外跟退休KGB探員成了朋友，荒謬又逗趣，評論反應不錯。
